_comment: Kit/SKU metadata for the customer-friendly configuration mode. Each entry maps deterministically to wizard state keys (mount, power, bathroom, airiq, ventiq, roomiq, fan, led, voice) and a firmware config_string that already exists in manifest.json. Do not add a kit without a matching config_string in manifest.json — the wizard will surface a 'no compatible firmware' error if the mapping is missing.
_authoring_notes: sku: stable, customer-facing kit identifier. Use the 'S360-KIT-...' prefix to keep these distinct from the per-module SKUs (S360-100, S360-200, ...) listed in CLAUDE.md.

wizard_state: state keys consumed by setState() in scripts/state.js. mount=ceiling is required (the wizard does not support wall mounts). power must be one of usb/poe/pwr. Module slots follow scripts/data/module-requirements.js.
firmware_config_string: must exactly match a build.config_string in manifest.json. The kit-config.js loader rejects entries that don't resolve.
firmware_channel: optional default channel preference. Provenance + release-channel UI still gate the actual install — kit metadata never bypasses those checks.

Mark kits as 'sample: true' if they are illustrative entries intended for integrators to replace with real SKUs. Sample kits are still functional but the diagnostics bundle records the sample flag so support can tell a real customer order from a demo selection.

WF-CLEANUP-010: the 6 legacy sample kits (AirIQ-POE/USB/PWR, Core-USB, Fan-USB, Bathroom-VentIQ-POE) were removed because their firmware_config_string values are no longer published in manifest.json. FanTRIAC and LED kits must not be added until the corresponding firmware ships — FanTRIAC stays blocked from Release-One and LED is excluded from Release-One via firmware/sources.json block_tokens.

kits.description: Release-One ceiling kit: Sense360 Core with the VentIQ bathroom air-quality module and the RoomIQ presence + comfort sensor, powered over Ethernet.
